verdict.rationale: Ardent gives developers instant isolated Postgres branches cloned from production, so they can test migrations and schema changes against real data without touching prod (CLI, per-PR branches in CI). Nothing in the evidence shows it applying those changes back to production: there is no merge-to-prod, deploy-request, or online/non-locking DDL mechanism. A community comment notes that migrations validated this way can still lock tables or break live services. missing for 10: online/non-blocking DDL execution against production, deploy requests or merge-back of branch schema changes, lock-safety guarantees during rollout, independent hands-on corroboration.
